Introduction

History of Erie County Family Court

The concept of Family Courts first emerged in the United States in the late 19th century. These courts were established with the goal of providing a more streamlined and efficient system for resolving family-related legal disputes. Erie County Family Court was established as part of this movement and has been serving the residents of Erie County for many years.

Erie County Family Court has jurisdiction over a wide range of legal matters that impact families. These include divorce and separation, child custody and support, domestic violence, and adoption. However, it's important to note that the court's jurisdiction is limited and there are certain cases that it cannot hear.
